note: Cold-verifier closure from aukora-toy at commit c512d0cb. THIS PIN REPLACES b288ff6 AND IS NOT THE SAME COURT: the accepted commit adds aukora-receipt/v3-genesis as a sibling kind. Genesis then extends the genesis-kind composition closed set with Diamond's required compositionDigest and subjectDigest (same per-kind pattern as priorHead on aura). Toy kinds are unchanged. The licence changed upstream at that commit — MIT at b288ff6, AGPL-3.0 here (LICENSE sha256 6ee2e371656b5d145196776174741c2cdcd2c0d22604ca79a1cb019cb8641a3b) — and nothing was relicensed by this repository. Only the cold verifier's transitive import closure is vendored. Each digest was computed from the file on disk after the last edit to covered bytes.

files.note: *** DEPARTS FROM UPSTREAM BYTES, ON KIRA'S CHANGE, NOT MINE: *** KIRA's `90b1dcad8` added a SMALL-ORDER CHECK to this toy ed25519 because it had none. **THE PIN WAS NOT UPDATED WITH THE CHANGE, SO `scripts/phase0-check-pins.py` HAS BEEN RED SINCE THAT COMMIT** — for a reason with nothing to do with licensing, and it was found while re-pinning the AGPL file. RE-PINNED HERE WITH THE DEPARTURE NAMED rather than the file reverted: a security fix to a vendored toy is a change worth keeping, and the pin's job is to make the set of differences enumerable, not to forbid them.

DEPARTS FROM UPSTREAM BYTES: the copyright-holder line was changed to 'Copyright (c) 2026 Aumara and Peter Viviani' by the 2026-09-26 licensing decision. THIS IS AUKORA'S OWN VENDORED PROJECT, so its holder line is ours to correct; the upstream text of the licence itself is otherwise untouched.

fixturesNote: Genesis-authored, NOT upstream bytes. Generated by the Genesis composition gate itself (scripts/composition) rather than copied from the toy, so the fixture is produced by the same code that issues receipts in production. Reminted so the composition block carries Diamond's required compositionDigest and subjectDigest. It is aukora-receipt/v3-genesis. No secret key is committed and no issuer.sk is present; the tests re-verify the signature from the public key alone.

genesisAuthored.why: A real aukora-receipt/v3-genesis receipt produced by the Genesis composition gate. Not upstream bytes; declared here so a missing fixture is a failure. Its digest is also recorded in `fixtures` above, which the receipt-v3 test enforces against the bytes.
The public key for that receipt. Public only: no issuer.sk is committed anywhere in this tree.
This manifest. A file cannot carry its own digest; the pin checker prints it instead.
Genesis-authored record of what was vendored, from which commit, under which licence, and what changed relative to the previous pin.
